conclusion: Both permitted live calls completed. The initial schema gate stopped on the exact dwcHeaders license alias; frozen raw replay resolved that false negative without a second live attempt. Exact local raw replay remains required for the usability decision.
limitations: Galah exposes a pandas-parsed table rather than the provider ZIP; the ignored CSV files are the earliest artifacts available to this pilot.
Requesting assertions sets qa=includeall and may expand assertion columns; galah also sets dwcHeaders=true.
Under dwcHeaders=true, the requested license field is returned under the one explicit alias dcterms:license.
